final_answer:
The root cause is an event-name mismatch. `src/checkout.js` sent `trackEvent("Purchase")`, but the experiment's metric listens for `purchase` in lowercase, so no conversions were ever counted (0 for both variants, even though users were being exposed).

I changed the call in `src/checkout.js` to `trackEvent("purchase")`. I haven't run the app or the experiment, so the fix is unverified. Conversions in the Flagsmith results should start appearing once the change is deployed.
